note: On Lake St. Catherine near Poultney, with two sandy beaches, a nature center and a snack bar renting canoes, kayaks and pedal boats. A few sites near the shore (37, 40, 42 and tent sites 44 and 47) look at the lake through a belt of conifers. --Claude
